epics.title: Offline Material Creation and Sync
epics.jtbd: When an educational center participant has no internet access, I want to be able to add materials offline, so that my work is saved locally and synchronized to the server when connection is restored.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase offline material creation success rate from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Allow offline creation of materials with local storage caching
R2: Automatically synchronize locally saved materials to the backend upon network reconnection

slices.title: Patch frontend for offline material creation and sync
slices.jtbd: When implementing the offline cache for this epic, I want to patch the frontend local storage and sync logic, so that the offline creation outcome is achieved safely.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an offline state, When a user adds a material, Then it is stored in the local cache.
Given a restored network connection, When the client reconnects, Then locally cached materials are synced to the backend API.
Given a successful sync, When the server confirms creation, Then the local cache is cleared of synced items.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce document data loss rate due to network disconnects from 100% to 0%

requirements: R1: Implement API pagination for document lists and search results

slices.title: Patch API endpoints for document pagination
slices.jtbd: When implementing pagination for this epic, I want to patch the existing document list and search endpoints, so that the faster page load outcome is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search request with page parameters, When the total results exceed the page size, Then the API returns the requested page of documents and the total count.
Given a list request with a specific page number, When that page has no results, Then the API returns an empty array.
Given a request without pagination parameters, When the endpoint is called, Then it falls back to a default page size.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Database query and network payload size bottleneck
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce API response time for large datasets from >1000ms to <200ms
